headings.style: clean, confident, technology-focused, tight letter spacing

colors.guidelines: Light background by default. High contrast typography. Use subtle dark/navy accents. Avoid excessive neon, large swaths of solid black, or gaudy gradients.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E2E8F0 (border-slate-200) for structural division. No heavy dropshadows.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use flat surfaces (bg-white) with subtle borders. Avoid neumorphism. Avoid dark heavy backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky navigation or floating action bars: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200.
visual_enhancers.textures: Minimal noise/grain is acceptable for background if subtle, but prioritize clean whitespace.

components.button: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or subtle rounding (rounded-lg). Solid dark (bg-slate-900 text-white) for primary, Outline (border border-slate-200 text-slate-900) for secondary. Hover state: -translate-y-0.5 and slightly lighter background. DO NOT USE shadow-xl.
components.card: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl or rounded-2xl p-6 or p-8. Hover: subtle border darkening (border-slate-300) or gentle lift (-translate-y-1). No excessive shadows.
components.navbar: Sticky, z-50, backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80, border-b border-slate-200. Clear logo/name on left, links in center, CTA on right. Must be visible on desktop (no hamburger menu unless mobile).

grids.bento_grid: Used for 'Categorized AI toolkit'. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gap-4 or gap-6. Mix spans: some col-span-2, some col-span-1.
grids.swiss_grid: Generous spacing. Use empty columns for negative space. Asymmetric alignments to break the generic centered layout.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. py-24 or py-32 for main sections. p-8 or p-12 inside large structural containers.
layouts.hero: Left-aligned or gracefully centered. Name + Headline + CTAs. Lots of breathing room. Incorporate the headshot elegantly.
layouts.case_studies: Three main case studies (AI Property Walkthrough, Reference-to-Image Generation, AI Avatar & Voice Clone). Alternating layouts or a clean vertical stack. Image on one side, text + workflow steps on the other.
layouts.workflow_7_step: A clean visual timeline or a 3-column grid mapping the 7 steps ('How I Work With AI'). Use subtle typography, not heavy graphics.

motion.reveals: Gentle Framer Motion reveals (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1, duration 0.6s, ease out).
motion.hover: Subtle image scaling (scale 1.05) inside overflow-hidden containers on hover. Gentle project card hover states.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast. Text sizes and colors must be legible. Focus states must have ring-2 ring-slate-900.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

media.aspect_ratios: Use 16:9 for case study heroes, 4:3 or 1:1 for thumbnails. Use object-cover.
media.images: Images must have overflow-hidden containers with subtle rounded corners. No heavy overlays unless necessary for text readability.

3d_libraries.directive: DO NOT USE 3D LIBRARIES. User explicitly requested 'restrained animations, avoid generic AI robot imagery, avoid gaming aesthetics'.

instructions_to_main_agent: The visual style must feel clean, sophisticated, minimal, professional, confident, and human.
Do NOT use cyberpunk design, neon, gaming aesthetics, excessive gradients, or generic AI robot imagery.
Use generous whitespace. Do not clutter the layout.
Prioritize excellent typography. Make headings bold, elegant, and readable.
Ensure subtle visual depth via light borders and muted colors, not deep shadows.
Avoid unnecessary dashboards and SaaS pricing page aesthetics.
Use a light background by default with subtle dark/navy accents.
Build 'How I Work With AI' as a clear, step-by-step visual timeline.
Categorize the AI toolkit nicely using a Bento Grid or clean list.
Keep interactions very subtle (smooth scrolling, gentle fade-ins).
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute.
Do NOT output the standard 'AI slop' look. Go for a 'Professional Consulting meets Modern Tech' aesthetic.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Design for all devices. Desktop, tablet, and mobile views must be flawless.
Maintain high contrast ratios for text.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
